name: North Branch Campfire 2024

venue.name: Private residence
venue.address: Address will be emailed to registered comeptitors

information:
**This competition is not recommended for first-timers or those looking for a typical competition experience.** This will be a small competition with a selection of uncommon events. We will not be holding typical events like 3x3 and Pyraminx.

This competition will be held outdoors and will be weather permitting. We advise against booking any non-refundable travel accommodations in case the competition needs to be cancelled due to inclement weather.

There will not be total silence for blindfolded events, but there will be pleasant nature sounds.

At most one guest per competitor is permitted. Lunch and dinner for all competitors and guests is included in the registration fee. Please let us know in the registration comments if you have any dietary restrictions.
